scope.completed_runtime_evidence: Local prepare, teacher preflight and four smoke runs only; no claim about completion or outputs of formal training.

registration.formal_remote_snapshot_verification: Pending future local backup; current local runtime files exactly match registration.

mechanism_checks.check: Actual layer input query and CPU grouped lookup
mechanism_checks.basis: Grouped search normalizes actual encoded layer queries and scans all stored keys; logsumexp cosine/T chooses one fact, then softmax mixes its three values. No target-ID filter, gold slot selector or eval oracle.

Tensor training and CPU grouped evaluation share _grouped_read; flat uses corresponding existing top-4 paths. Hard group choice is nondifferentiable; dense group_address_loss supplies routing gradients outside the selected fact.
A8/B8 examples use 16 independent banks. Each B bank changes only its own target payload under the same entity/question; target_answers aligns world order and ep.local_targets.

Actual 64x128 entity-plus-payload observations are independently frozen-encoded. Static/rebind share target/background/order RNG, exhaust 64 entities per eight-step epoch and supervise all 128 payloads once per epoch. Statistics use only 128 static AB observations and 64 training queries.

Teacher has current single support and bypasses VDB; training contains sequence CE plus address CE only. initialize enforces canonical training AB whitelist. Development axes exclude D; eval uses frozen modules and current observed vectors. Precomputed D features do not enter optimization/statistics/selection.

Each target/world starts from clean A, writes all three target slots atomically, checks non-target preservation, evaluates fixed neighbor, restores A and checks keys/values. Shuffling cycles whole fact values while preserving keys and order within each three-slot group; empty bank is actually empty.

Greedy max_new_tokens=32, one route per generated token including initial prediction, strict full-answer normalized EM, R1 from maximal weight rather than list order, current question only. Target IDs are consulted only after generation for metric annotation.

confirmed_budgets.notes: Formal budget counts are protocol/plan/code derived, not completed-run claims; smoke calls and bank/control materialization are separate.

completed_smoke_evidence.interpretation: Pipeline, differentiability and lifecycle checks, not learning efficacy.

nonblocking_reporting_boundaries: Grouped selected_fact is not a standalone serialized prediction trace field; it is exactly recoverable as indices[0]//3 because all three indices belong to one fact. Empty retrieval has no selected fact. Flat may mix several facts and must not be assigned one grouped selected_fact.

Training read_diagnostics uses captured gold-prefix prediction inputs including EOS, before optimizer update, under no_grad without another backbone forward. residual_rms is the adapter delta before addition/BF16 rounding, not post-addition residual/base RMS ratio or free-generation residual.

Same target/payload exposure and gold-token multiset hold across full epochs, not necessarily within one step or separately within A and B sides. Background content residency can differ with regime and is logged.
Grouped reads three values versus flat four; both scan all keys. This is not identical value-read budget or independent address/content encoding.
Additive readout is a diagnostic excluded from candidate selection; success/failure alone cannot isolate multiplicative VeRA as the sole cause.

A/B values are deliberately shared across known/new-entity banks to isolate entity generalization. C/D are paired single-word replacements and templates are historically known; this is not arbitrary unseen-language or cross-domain generalization.
